WQM category 'Default' does not exist on the target platform

findings: With SELECT on the product schema, the operator is stopped at schedule validation: the WQM category read is refused by the platform (no %Admin_Operate) and the validator reports it as CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND "does not exist" — a platform refusal mislabelled (pre-existing, spec 004 validator; not changed here).

The platform refusal of the create itself (403 with platformStatus, verbatim, rollback of earlier creates) is proven by ScheduleViaPlatformTest; on this instance an operator able to read WQM categories needs %Admin_Operate, which the platform also accepts for task creation.
